topic: PF on *WhatsApp*: EPFO adds chat service
hook: PF on *WhatsApp*: EPFO adds chat services, auto-settles dormant accounts
hook_b: Old PF account from your first job? It may settle itself
tldr: Labour Minister Mansukh Mandaviya launched WhatsApp PF info and auto-settlement of dormant accounts.

beats.what: EPFO launched WhatsApp access to routine PF info and auto-settlement of eligible inoperative accounts.
beats.why: The ministry says the aim is to simplify EPFO services for members.
beats.care: Switched jobs and left a PF account behind? Check if it's eligible for auto-settlement.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Per NDTV Profit: Union Labour Minister Mansukh Mandaviya launched two EPFO initiatives: WhatsApp-based access to routine PF information (the report mentions balance and passbook checks), and automatic settlement of eligible inoperative accounts. NDTV's headline puts the first batch at about 1 lakh dormant accounts. The WhatsApp number, eligibility rules for auto-settlement and timelines were not in the summary we could read; check epfindia.gov.in.

cards.q: Would you check your PF on WhatsApp?

insight: Eligible inoperative PF accounts will now be settled automatically, without a claim.

learn.t: Inoperative PF account = one with no contributions for a long time, often left after a job switch.

watch: The official WhatsApp number and auto-settlement rules on epfindia.gov.in.
